name: podium-reporter
description: Reports this Claude Code session (model, effort, plan, agents, context, cost, git, failures) to a local Podium fleet console.

serverUrl.title: Podium server URL
serverUrl.description: Where the reporter posts session reports.

token.title: Podium token
token.description: Sent as X-Podium-Token. Use the token the server owner made for you in Podium Admin (it only works with your user name), or the server's admin secret on a single-user setup. Leave empty when the server has no token.

userName.title: Your name in Podium
userName.description: The name the server owner gave you when they made your token. The server accepts your reports only when the token and this name match. Leave empty on a single-user setup.

flushIntervalMs.title: Report interval (ms)
flushIntervalMs.description: Minimum time between reports while something changes.

heartbeatMs.title: Heartbeat (ms)
heartbeatMs.description: Report at least this often even when nothing changed.

sessionName.title: Session name
sessionName.description: Display name for this machine's sessions. Usually left empty.

showStatus.title: Status line
showStatus.description: Show 'podium ● N live' or 'podium ○ offline' under the prompt.

explainFailures.title: Explain failures
explainFailures.description: Ask a small model to explain each failure (costs tokens). Off by default.

fullPrompts.title: Send full prompts and answers
fullPrompts.description: Send each agent's whole task prompt and final answer (up to 20,000 characters each, secrets redacted) so the console can show them in full. Off by default: only the first 400 characters are sent.
